corpus.pinned_by: sha256 and git blob sha in PROVENANCE.json
corpus.why_this_corpus: real pre- and post-repair sources with their exact unchanged upstream test bodies, so a transfer claim can be judged by the injured project's own tests rather than by a fixture written for the occasion

consequences: facts must be able to express absence, or the unit of observation must become (target, site) rather than target

site-relative facts still blur: they are a union over all nine firing sites, so operator.LtE is present in both before.py and after.py, and what actually disappears is the defect site's own left operand
fact_vocabulary.placeholder_facts_are_forbidden: an earlier prototype emitted site.no_enclosing_comparison for an offset outside any comparison; because that happened in every real case the law returned it as the most general survivor -- a constant dressed as a finding
fact_vocabulary.survivors_reduction: 1024 -> 0 on the same evidence, and the verdict changes from AMBIGUOUS to INCONSISTENT
fact_vocabulary.what_is_not_expressible: that the defect is an operator boundary rather than a missing guard
fact_vocabulary.why_constant_facts_matter: all four real targets already fail their own tests, so Round F's requirement baseline.violates_own_spec is present in every observation and refuted by none; a fact true of everything is not a requirement
fact_vocabulary.why_inconsistent_is_the_useful_refusal: it says the VOCABULARY is wrong rather than the evidence being thin: the two failures' site-fact sets (45 facts each) are supersets of the two successes' (10 and 7), so no conjunction of PRESENT facts can separate them

sources_consulted.bearing: curated skills +16.2pp but self-generated skills -1.3pp and 16 of 84 tasks negative; the common cause is a single correct pipeline without applicability boundaries, and the stated implication is that skills should include applicability boundaries not just preferred procedures
sources_consulted.id: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks

sources_consulted.bearing: formalizes an applicability condition C, a skill should activate only when its procedural knowledge is beneficial; documents ClawHavoc where overbroad skill descriptions widened the attack surface
sources_consulted.id: SoK: Agentic Skills -- Beyond Tool Use in LLM Agents

sources_consulted.bearing: negatives generated from positive seeds by small edit operations against a deterministic oracle, plus a hardening pass over a probe pool for witnesses where gold and candidate disagree
sources_consulted.id: Counterexamples as feedback for agent self-correction (A-CEGIS)

sources_consulted.bearing: court-form-filling case: a heuristic true for medical intake and false for legal forms, where refinement re-explored the same training data and baked it deeper -- the argument against synthesizing contrasts only near the original demonstration
sources_consulted.id: SkillEvolver: Skill Learning as a Meta-Skill

sources_consulted.bearing: names false lesson propagation, a spurious causal lesson from a small number of trajectories applied in an inappropriate context, and identifies environment-feedback bandwidth as the missing variable
sources_consulted.id: When Skills Don't Help: A Negative Result on Procedural Knowledge for Tool-Grounded Agents

sources_consulted.bearing: 39 of 49 skills produce zero delta and the average is +1.2%; near-match templates cause surface anchoring and concept bleed. A skill proposing 0 candidates is a zero delta by construction
sources_consulted.id: SWE-Skills-Bench: Do Agent Skills Actually Help in Real Repositories

the_defect.consequence: the rule is stored, marked state ACTIVE, and fires nowhere; nothing in the tree asks whether a stored skill fires at all
the_defect.what_the_production_teaching_path_receiv: the two whole 1317-line files, exactly as canonical/tests/historical_repair_curriculum_v1.py passes them
the_defect.why_derive_operator_swap_is_right_to_ref: it returns a swap only when the two token streams differ at exactly one operator position, and this pair differs in a docstring as well

the_fix.granularity: the smallest AST STATEMENT covering each changed region, not the enclosing function
the_fix.why_statement_granularity: the enclosing function of the real boltons fix also contains the changed docstring, so it carries two differences and is refused

the_two_real_failures.corpus_control: each case's real upstream fix does pass its own tests, so the failure belongs to the skill and not to a broken harness
the_two_real_failures.recorded_as: FIRED_AND_NOT_REPAIRED_WITHIN_BUDGET with the budget stated, never as a pass and never as a non-firing

title: A real repair is a whole file and a lesson is one statement

transfer_headline.reached_by: the swap family, whose dual form ('>','>=') is that module's real historical fix
transfer_headline.taught_from: boltons/strutils.py::bytes2human (real historical repair, localized to one statement)

trap_pinned.what_happened: with pytest absent from the sandbox, bits_capacity's upstream test failed at 'from pytest import raises', the oracle reported test_count 0, and even the sha256-pinned upstream fix returned non-zero
trap_pinned.why_it_matters: counting that as a failure of the skill would fabricate a contrasting observation out of a missing dependency -- the same error class as counting a PASS that only proved a process started

what_is_not: that the localized lesson is the right lesson for the corpus: it repaired 2 of 4 real bugs and failed on 2

that crystallize_code_fix now localizes: it does not, and editing it was deliberately avoided because teaching a localized pair while verifying a whole file would break its downstream reproduction checks verify_rule_on_mutated_twin and iter_crystallized_code_rule_candidates, which assume the rule reproduces after_snippet from before_snippet
that the shipped corpus has scopes: it does not, and the ledger is unchanged at 5 of 5 EXACT_MATCH_ONLY
that the scope law now works on real code: it returns INCONSISTENT here and that is the finding
that this is a benchmark result or model training: no model was called and every verdict is an executed test suite over pinned real sources
that the fixtures are independently certified: PROVENANCE.json declares independent_certification false
